australia-car-insurance-in-new-zealand.title: Driving an Australian car in New Zealand.
australia-car-insurance-in-new-zealand.description: What RACV says about cover outside Australia when taking your own car to New Zealand, and what to confirm before shipping.

blocks.x: What RACV says about cover outside Australia when taking your own car to New Zealand, and what to confirm before shipping.

Short answer: Do not assume your Australian car insurance applies in New Zealand. The cited RACV Motor Insurance wording excludes loss or damage outside Australia. Check your exact policy edition and arrange separate insurance where needed.
What RACV says

The July 2026 RACV Motor Insurance PDS includes a general exclusion for loss or damage occurring outside Australia, and explains that general exclusions apply to the policy. The quoted result is for the motor policy covered by that booklet; other products, endorsements or specialist marine policies require separate verification.
Do you need insurance during shipping?

Motor insurance for ordinary road use and shipping/marine transit protection are distinct. Ask the shipping company and an appropriate insurer what covers loss or damage during collection, transit, unloading and storage. Never infer this from the standard motor policy.
Before driving in New Zealand

Check temporary import permission, local vehicle standards and registration, driver licensing, compulsory legal requirements and the territorial validity of your new insurance. The destination’s current official guidance and your written insurer confirmation take precedence over this summary.

ie-car-insurance-in-uk.title: Irish car insurance in the UK.
ie-car-insurance-in-uk.description: Understand car insurance from Ireland to Great Britain or Northern Ireland: home territorial cover, Green Cards and documentation.

blocks.x: Understand car insurance from Ireland to Great Britain or Northern Ireland: home territorial cover, Green Cards and documentation.

Short answer: Aviva Ireland, Allianz Ireland and 123.ie list Great Britain or Northern Ireland within their normal territorial cover. AXA Ireland confirms that an Irish-registered car does not need a Green Card for UK travel, including Northern Ireland.
How published policy territories differ from EU extensions

Allianz Ireland’s motor wording includes Great Britain, Northern Ireland and the Channel Islands in its home territorial limits. 123.ie likewise says full policy cover applies in these locations without advance travel notification. Aviva Ireland confirms that its car insurance covers Northern Ireland and Great Britain.
What evidence should you take?

Carry your current motor-insurance certificate and Irish insurance disc, driving licence and registration. AXA Ireland confirms that the Irish insurance disc can act as the accepted proof for the UK, rather than a Green Card. If your policy is from another insurer, check its latest certificate and schedule.
EU day caps are not always relevant

Do not automatically deduct a UK trip from an “EU extension” limit. The definition of territorial limits, and whether particular journeys use up foreign-use days, is insurer-specific. Check the exact wording where your company offers both.

irish-car-insurance-in-france.title: Irish car insurance in France.
irish-car-insurance-in-france.description: Aviva Ireland, Allianz Ireland and 123.ie foreign-use cover in France: 31, 60 and 30-day conditions compared.

blocks.x: Aviva Ireland, Allianz Ireland and 123.ie foreign-use cover in France: 31, 60 and 30-day conditions compared.

Short answer: Aviva Ireland publishes automatic EU cover up to 31 days. Allianz Ireland offers its selected home cover for up to 60 days per insurance period. 123.ie provides the EU legal minimum automatically but requires advance arrangement for up to 30 days of full Irish cover.
Aviva Ireland: automatic 31-day extension

Aviva’s public guidance says an existing Irish car policy is extended into the EU for up to 31 days. The exact level of cover, exclusions and how the 31 days are counted should be confirmed from your policy booklet, rather than assumed to be an annual allowance.
Allianz Ireland: 60 days per insurance period

Allianz’s motor policy wording gives a 60-day automatic extension to continental Europe for the cover selected at home. Its wording also discusses a separate European legal-minimum protection. Roadside recovery is limited geographically and should not be assumed to accompany comprehensive insurance.
123.ie: request full cover in advance

The 123.ie customer-care page explains that only the legal minimum is automatic for EU member states. To keep full Irish policy cover for up to 30 days, you need to ask in advance and receive approval. The tool offers two separate selections so you do not mistake a possible extension for one you actually purchased.
What to check before France
Your policy year, holiday dates, permitted drivers and previous trips.
Whether the damage/theft benefits of your Irish plan apply abroad.
Breakdown, recovery and accommodation cover, which may have different territory rules.
The certificate, vehicle registration and French driving requirements.

new-zealand-car-insurance-in-australia.title: An NZ-insured car in Australia.
new-zealand-car-insurance-in-australia.description: Review AMI motor-policy exclusions for driving a New Zealand-registered car in Australia and the separate cover to arrange.

blocks.x: Review AMI motor-policy exclusions for driving a New Zealand-registered car in Australia and the separate cover to arrange.
Short answer: AMI’s cited November 2024 policy wording states that it does not cover incidents outside New Zealand. A car shipped to Australia needs its own transport and road-insurance arrangements.
Read the geographic exclusion

The AMI car policy’s exclusions section explicitly rules out incidents outside New Zealand. This applies across the cited cover levels; a comprehensive label does not cancel a geographic exclusion. Always check the wording edition on your own schedule and any special endorsement.
Australia has a different insurance system

Australian compulsory third-party bodily-injury schemes differ by state and territory, and they are not equivalent to comprehensive property damage cover. Vehicle registration, temporary importation, licensing and local liability requirements all matter. Arrange an insurer-issued, destination-valid policy before using the car on Australian roads.
What about the voyage?
Shipping, transit and storage may need marine cargo or another specifically agreed policy. Ask for written confirmation of cover from pickup through unloading and subsequent legal road use.

uk-car-insurance-in-france.title: Does UK insurance cover France?
uk-car-insurance-in-france.description: Understand UK car insurance in France: legal third-party cover, insurer day limits, Green Cards and what to take on a road trip.

blocks.x: Understand UK car insurance in France: legal third-party cover, insurer day limits, Green Cards and what to take on a road trip.
Short answer: UK car insurance provides the minimum legal third-party cover in France. Whether damage to your own vehicle is also covered depends on your insurer, policy tier and how long you stay.
What does minimum cover actually pay for?

Third-party liability addresses your legal responsibility for harm to other people or their property. It is not a promise that your own car will be repaired or replaced after a collision or theft. The UK Government makes this distinction explicit and advises contacting your insurer about extra protection.
Examples of published insurer limits

Limits in this table are based on the named published products—not a claim that every policy sold under a familiar insurer’s brand is identical. Count earlier foreign-use days where the cap is expressed per policy year.
Do UK motorists need a Green Card for France?

No Green Card is normally needed for a UK-insured car in France. You still need valid insurance and should carry the insurance certificate, driving licence and V5C or the applicable proof for a leased vehicle. Check official rules for every country through which you drive.
What if the trip is longer than your allowance?

Contact the insurer before departure to request an extension and written confirmation. Do not assume a second short trip resets a policy-year total. Separately check European breakdown and recovery cover: insurance for an accident is not the same as roadside rescue.

uk-car-insurance-in-ireland.title: UK car insurance in Ireland.
uk-car-insurance-in-ireland.description: UK-to-Ireland motor insurance: UK third-party minimum, AA and LV Ireland exceptions, and whether a Green Card is needed.

blocks.x: UK-to-Ireland motor insurance: UK third-party minimum, AA and LV Ireland exceptions, and whether a Green Card is needed.

Short answer: Active UK motor insurance provides the legal minimum third-party cover when you drive in the Republic of Ireland. You normally do not need a Green Card. Some insurers also exempt Ireland from their foreign-use day caps.
Which insurers publish an Ireland exception?

The AA says Ireland lies within its territorial limits, and policyholders retain their UK cover level there throughout the year. LV= explicitly says its 180-day foreign-use limit does not apply to the Republic of Ireland. Allianz Online’s policy wording likewise excludes Ireland from its published European day limits. These are insurer-specific exceptions , not a rule to apply to every UK policy.
What about Saga, Admiral or other UK insurers?

Do not assume that “EU cover” means Ireland is exempt from annual limits. Saga’s December 2025 wording gives 90 days for Standard, 180 days for Select and no limit for Plus across listed destinations that include Ireland. Admiral advertises up to 90 days of European cover per policy term for its eligible comprehensive tiers, excluding Essential. Your own issued booklet may set further restrictions.
Green Card and documents

GOV.UK lists Ireland among countries where UK drivers do not normally need a Green Card. Take your insurance certificate, your driving licence and appropriate vehicle-registration documents. If towing a trailer, using a company vehicle or travelling through other countries, check the relevant separate rules.
Check Northern Ireland versus the Republic of Ireland

Northern Ireland is part of the UK, while the Republic of Ireland is a separate country and EU member state. Insurers can use distinct definitions of “territorial limits,” so select the right destination in your policy documents rather than relying on the word “Ireland” alone.

uk-green-card-rules.title: The Green Card decision guide.
uk-green-card-rules.description: Which European destinations are Green Card-free for UK drivers, and where you may need proof or border insurance.

blocks.x: Which European destinations are Green Card-free for UK drivers, and where you may need proof or border insurance.

Short answer: UK drivers normally do not need a Green Card in EU or EEA member states, including Ireland, or in several other European countries. Some countries—including Albania, Turkey and Ukraine—can require a Green Card or other border-insurance proof.
Where a Green Card normally is not needed

GOV.UK lists the European Union (including Ireland), Andorra, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Montenegro, Norway, Serbia and Switzerland as Green Card-free for UK motorists. The Motor Insurers’ Bureau also describes a Green Card Free Circulation Area. Not carrying a Green Card does not mean you may drive uninsured.
Destinations that need more checking

The Motor Insurers’ Bureau identifies Albania, Azerbaijan, Moldova, North Macedonia, Tunisia, Turkey and Ukraine among destinations where proof may be required. GOV.UK also discusses Israel and Morocco. National border rules, insurer participation and acceptable proof formats may change, so confirm with both insurer and official destination guidance before departure.
How to get the right document

Ask your insurer for a Green Card or other required evidence, including any necessary cover for a trailer or caravan. GOV.UK advises arranging it in advance and checking whether a printout is needed. Some countries may require border insurance if your existing policy is not accepted.
What a Green Card does not prove

It is evidence of the minimum liability cover, not necessarily own-car protection, breakdown cover or unlimited foreign-use days. Your main insurance policy and the countries listed on its certificate remain crucial.

us-car-insurance-in-canada.title: US car insurance in Canada.
us-car-insurance-in-canada.description: Check Progressive, GEICO and USAA insurance when driving your own US-insured car into Canada. Cover levels, proof and limitations.

blocks.x: Check Progressive, GEICO and USAA insurance when driving your own US-insured car into Canada. Cover levels, proof and limitations.

Short answer: Progressive and GEICO confirm their U.S. personal auto cover ordinarily applies when driving your insured vehicle in Canada. USAA confirms Canadian liability cover. Always check your declarations for the exact benefits and limits.
What Progressive says

Progressive states its U.S. personal auto policy automatically covers driving in Canada. Its published advice also says your normal policy coverages and limits generally follow you on a temporary road trip. This does not mean a rental car is always insured the same way as your own car.
What GEICO says
GEICO’s March 2026 guide states that regular GEICO auto insurance extends into Canada. Carry normal proof of insurance and request any additional documentation your insurer recommends.
What USAA confirms—and what it does not

USAA says its auto policy meets or exceeds requirements for the insured vehicle to be driven in Canada and covers bodily-injury and property-damage liability. Its same FAQ warns that USAA insurance does not cover liability and physical damage for a vehicle rented in Canada. The published paragraph should not be expanded into a guarantee of collision or comprehensive benefits for every policyholder.
Before the border
Carry your insurance ID card or declarations page and your registration.
Verify the named driver, vehicle and period of your trip.
Confirm roadside assistance and repair arrangements if you will drive far from home.
For long stays, check provincial registration and residency rules; temporary tourism is different from relocation.

us-car-insurance-in-mexico.title: US car insurance in Mexico.
us-car-insurance-in-mexico.description: Find out why regular US car insurance usually does not meet Mexican liability requirements, and what coverage to buy before driving south.

blocks.x: Find out why regular US car insurance usually does not meet Mexican liability requirements, and what coverage to buy before driving south.

Short answer: A normal U.S. personal auto policy generally does not satisfy the Mexican-issued liability-insurance requirement. Arrange a qualifying Mexican tourist motor policy before driving your car across the border.
Progressive, GEICO and USAA

Progressive explicitly advises visitors to buy appropriate Mexican auto insurance; GEICO provides access to Mexico-specific insurance rather than extending a regular U.S. policy; USAA’s FAQ states that its domestic auto policy does not provide the Mexican liability cover required by law. These are direct insurer statements—not estimates about individual claims.
What should the Mexican policy include?

Check for locally accepted third-party bodily-injury and property-damage liability for the vehicle, driver, dates and regions you will use. Ask about optional physical damage, theft, legal assistance, roadside recovery, deductibles and limits. Do not treat an add-on to your U.S. policy as a substitute for the Mexican-issued liability policy unless accepted by the relevant authorities.
Be careful with border exceptions

Progressive notes a narrow physical-damage exception for certain Texas policyholders on occasional drives near the border. Even where such an exception exists, Mexican legal liability insurance is still needed . Check the insurer’s exact written terms.
Before leaving
Obtain an authorised Mexico insurance policy valid for the car and entire journey.
Keep policy documents accessible in the language and form required.
Check vehicle import permits and border paperwork for your route.
Confirm claims and legal-assistance contact numbers, not just the quote price.
